items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember one record date we did, Bobby Shad was there, was the A&R guy.

ctx.x: They met, and he liked the way she sang. So they got together and made some things. I’m trying to think if it was Bobby Shad or who it was that hooked all this – was the . . .
A&R [artists and repertory] guy at the time?
